Class MessageDbService

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.service.MessageDbService
public final class MessageDbService extends Object
Persistent message store backed by H2, using the shared ~/.meshapp/nodedb database.

Channel and DM messages are saved immediately on receive/send. FormChat loads messages in batches of 50, paginated by id.

Chat types (chat_type):

  • "channel" - channel messages, chat_key = channelIndex
  • "dm" - direct messages, chat_key = peerNodeNum

    • countMessageSearchMatchesLimited

      public MessageDbService.MessageSearchCount countMessageSearchMatchesLimited(String chatType, String chatKey, String query, String ownerNodeId)
      Counts search matches through the full-text index with an upper limit.

      An exact COUNT(*) for a common word can scan a very large set of FT rows. The UI therefore gets an exact count in normal scenarios, and a capped value with MessageDbService.MessageSearchCount.limited() for overly frequent queries.

      Parameters:
      chatType - chat type
      chatKey - chat key
      query - search string
      ownerNodeId - owner device nodeId
      Returns:
      number of matches, possibly capped
